receipts.sharp_question: How do we prevent an adversarial gauntlet/audit from injecting false fixes when it was run on an incomplete source?

dewy_vector.D: Adopt ADR-061: no audit/gauntlet/skeptic flag is applied until re-verified by the operator against the FULL primary source (authoritative transcript + profiles + external-doc fetch); reject over-flags explicitly and log them; never blind-apply a prescribed fix; check quote provenance deterministically.
dewy_vector.E: The counterpart-gauntlet workflow, the dual-bar-raiser, the deterministic checker (provcheck.py), the operator.
dewy_vector.W: Standing discipline, effective immediately, generalizes to any promoted ADR/handoff/canon and the meta-audit.
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN — validated in the same session: caught 3 over-flags incl. the gauntlet's own #1 top-fix; one blind-apply would have replaced a truth with a new fabrication.

receipts.why: A gauntlet is only as honest as its source-of-truth. An abbreviated scratchpad transcript manufactured a top-ranked false 'fabrication' flag; deterministic re-verification against the re-pulled full transcript + profiles refuted it.
receipts.outcome: ADR-061 written + registered; falsification ledger established (_STATE/falsification-ledger.jsonl) recording both real defects and rejected over-flags.

receipts.sharp_question: Where do the Kam gauntlet results get logged so the flywheel's test-and-falsify surface stays canonical?

dewy_vector.D: Append the Kam finding as falsification F32 to the canonical _STATE/falsification-ledger.jsonl (F# schema: claim/test/verdict/delta/fix), regenerate the Hypercube Gauntlet logbook via scripts/gauntlet_logbook.py, and republish the artifact in place. Align main's copy to the canonical schema.
dewy_vector.E: The canonical falsification ledger + scripts/gauntlet_logbook.py + the published logbook artifact (76ca345d), the building-in-public flywheel, the operator.
dewy_vector.W: Append-only, ongoing; F32 is the newest row.
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN — F32 on the tape (32 entries, 15 canon-linked); artifact republished; main copy reconciled.

receipts.why: I first created a parallel wrong-schema file believing none existed — a source-check (the published artifact + the hypercube-gauntlet branch) falsified that: the canonical ledger already existed with 31 F# entries. Reconciled to it rather than forking a second ledger. (This is ADR-061 applied to my own claim.)
receipts.outcome: F32 appended to canonical ledger; artifact 76ca345d republished (32 falsifications); main's _STATE/falsification-ledger.jsonl aligned to F# schema. NOTE: full script+tape live on branch dazzling-khorana-efca37 (unmerged) — reconcile F32 at that merge.
